name: Net Isoplot
description: Live heatmap of along-copper distance from a selected pad/via across its net
description_full: Select any pad or via and open Net Isoplot: a window beside KiCad colours every point of that net by its geodesic (along-copper) distance from the selection, across all copper layers joined by vias and plated holes. Red marks points near the selection, blue the furthest ones - a quick visual aid for spotting and shortening current loops. The window stays open and updates live as you select other pads or edit the board. Requires KiCad 9.0.5+ with the KiCad API enabled (Preferences > Plugins).
